note: call_cap.default = safety cap on gateway calls when no plugin and no --cap gives one (measured on our benches: 60 calls). review_title_threshold = token overlap above which a title is treated as a forbidden review. code_intervals = minimum seconds between two calls to the same host for the code engines.

verifier.note: One call per card; above max_chars_per_call (characters of sources), one call per source. A threshold to measure, not a fixed reference value.

claude.note: Claude Code host: the prompt goes on stdin; the caller adds --allowedTools / --disallowedTools; cwd = work dir; env without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

openai.note: Codex CLI host: the prompt goes on stdin ('-'), read-only sandbox, web search disabled; cwd = work dir.

contradictor.note: Optional contradictor after the report (tools/contradictor.py). families: empty = option absent; set it here, or VP_CONTRADICTORS, or ~/.config/vp/contradictors. models: codex = the Codex CLI (openai host profile, 0 USD on a subscription), the natural other family on a Claude Code host; claude = `claude -p` (claude host profile), the other family on a Codex host, not measured; kimi and gemini = OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), optional. Measured on 6 code cases: codex, kimi and gemini passed the frozen criterion (gemini adds almost as many errors as it detects). y_cap_chars = the cut of Y used in the measure. max_usd = ceiling on the rereads (host model) per run; reread_model per host profile = the model that reread in the measure (claude) or the host's model (openai).
